Asynchronous REST API optimized for loading, deleting, and querying large data sets in Salesforce. Supports CSV-based data operations on standard and custom objects. Jobs progress through lifecycle states (Open, UploadComplete, InProgress, JobComplete, Failed, Aborted) and can process millions of records efficiently.
